newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices improve marginally.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices improve marginally.

text.p: Sugar prices rose modestly on Friday on a marginal rise in demand, traders said.
"The market undertone was subdued," said a trader. "But we expect sentiment to firm in the next few days.
In ready delivery, S-30 gained 5.0 rupees to 1,350/1,380 rupees per quintal. M-30 was 2.0 rupees up at 1,387/1,460 rupees per quintal.
There were no offers from mills.
Traders said they would expect demand for sugar to rise along with the temperature in the summer months of May, June and July when consumption of sugar-based soft drinks would go up.
